raw_posts.name: Talanoa
raw_posts.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

raw_posts.name: Navige
raw_posts.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
raw_posts.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

raw_posts.name: Apple HomeView
raw_posts.tagline: A new way to stay connected, and manage the home
raw_posts.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.

raw_posts.name: GLM-Legal
raw_posts.tagline: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance
raw_posts.description: LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

raw_posts.name: OpenMuse
raw_posts.tagline: Opensource, self hostable personal assistant for any harness
raw_posts.description: OpenMuse is an open-source, self-hostable personal agent with its own browser, terminal, files, and persistent work. Ask for an outcome, watch it work, review actions, and come back to the result. Compatible with any agent harness.

raw_posts.name: Daddy Issues
raw_posts.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
raw_posts.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

raw_posts.name: Polylane Impact Analysis
raw_posts.tagline: Catch risky pull requests before they break production
raw_posts.description: Catch issues before they break production. Polylane reviews every pull request against your live infrastructure: its config, capacity, dependencies and telemetry. For every pull request, you get a an analysis including all the evidence telling you if the pull request is safe to merge against production. Polylane also proposes missing instrumentation on your branch and keeps watching after deployment.

raw_posts.name: withHuman
raw_posts.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
raw_posts.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

raw_posts.name: Chatway MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Let ChatGPT & Claude answer customer support tickets via MCP
raw_posts.description: Chatway is a live chat and customer support platform that lets you bring your own AI agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage customer conversations, reply to messages, search contacts, and access your knowledge base. No coding required. Chatway also includes a built-in AI Support Agent, shared inbox, help center, automation, iOS and Android apps, and integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and more. Get started for free.

raw_posts.tagline: GNOME 51, Rust coreutils, and a refreshed Linux desktop
